pages.text: Taro and Mumu each carried a bamboo container for water. Taro's was short. Mumu's was long.
"I'm thirsty. Let's get water at the well!" "Okay!" They ran off carrying their containers.
They stood the two containers side by side at the well and filled them to the top. Then they sat in the shade to rest.
A chicken fluttered between the containers. It pushed them around, switching their places. Both were still full of water.
Neither friend saw it happen. Taro picked up one container. Mumu picked up the other.
Taro gulped and gulped, but the water did not run out. "Oh? There's still more!"
Mumu's container was empty after two sips. "Did I drink it all already?" Mumu shook it.
Taro looked down. The container was as long as his forearm. "This isn't mine!"
They stood the two containers side by side. One was short and one was long. "We switched!"
But Taro would not let go of the long one. "I like how much water it holds." Mumu liked how light the short one was. They decided to keep them switched.
